question.text: A Category III AIF close-ended fund can be wound up by investor resolution passed at a meeting of unit holders representing:

answer.text: 75% by value of their investment in the fund

explanation.text: The Logic: A Category III AIF close-ended scheme may be wound up by a resolution passed at a meeting of unit holders representing 75% by value of their investment in the fund. The Trap: 50% and 100% (unanimous) are not the prescribed thresholds. Two-thirds (66.67%) by value is the threshold for tenure extension, not for winding-up. Note: Do not confuse the two-thirds tenure-extension threshold with the 75% winding-up threshold.
